questions.questionTextEn: A point charge +q is held at a distance d above an infinite grounded conducting plane at z = 0. The total electrostatic force of attraction experienced by the charge +q toward the conducting plane is:

[Electricity & Magnetism (Method of Images) • IIT JAM Physics (PH) • Feb 2024]

A point charge +q is held at a distance d above an infinite grounded conducting plane at z = 0. The total electrostatic force of attraction experienced by the charge +q toward the conducting plane is:
questions.explanationEn: By the method of images, the grounded plane at z = 0 is replaced by an image charge −q at z = −d (separation 2d from +q). Thus F = q² / [4π ε0 (2d)²] = q² / (16π ε0 d²).
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Physics (PH) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
By the method of images, the grounded plane at z = 0 is replaced by an image charge −q at z = −d (separation 2d from +q). Thus F = q² / [4π ε0 (2d)²] = q² / (16π ε0 d²).

questions.questionTextEn: A 6 V Zener diode is used in a shunt voltage regulator circuit with a series resistor R_s = 200 Ω connected to an unregulated DC input V_in = 12 V, and a load resistor R_L = 600 Ω across the Zener diode. The Zener current I_Z is:

आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Physics (PH) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।

optionsEn: The Brewster angle of incidence is θ_B = 60°.
The reflected ray is 100% linearly polarized perpendicular to the plane of incidence (s-polarized).

में a Newton's rings experiment using monochromatic light, यदि the diameter of the 4th dark ring is 4.0 mm, then the diameter (में mm) of the 9th dark ring is ________.
questions.explanationEn: The diameter of the n-th dark ring in reflected light is proportional to √n (D_n = 2√(n R λ)). Therefore, D_9 / D_4 = √(9 / 4) = 3 / 2 => D_9 = (3/2) × 4.0 mm = 6.0 mm.

विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
The diameter of the n-th dark ring in reflected light is proportional to √n (D_n = 2√(n R λ)). Therefore, D_9 / D_4 = √(9 / 4) = 3 / 2 => D_9 = (3/2) × 4.0 mm = 6.0 mm.

questions.questionTextEn: Two radioactive sources A (half-life T_A = 2 hours) and B (half-life T_B = 4 hours) initially contain equal numbers of radioactive nuclei (N_A(0) = N_B(0)). After 4 hours, the ratio of their activities (Activity of A / Activity of B) is ________.
questions.questionTextHi:
[Nuclear Physics (Radioactive Activity) • IIT JAM Physics (PH) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
Two radioactive sources A (अर्ध-आयु (half-life) T_A = 2 hours) and B (अर्ध-आयु (half-life) T_B = 4 hours) initially contaमें equal numbers of radioactive nuclei (N_A(0) = N_B(0)). After 4 hours, the ratio of their activities (Activity of A / Activity of B) is ________.
questions.explanationEn: Initial activity ratio R_A(0)/R_B(0) = (λ_A N_0)/(λ_B N_0) = T_B / T_A = 4 / 2 = 2. After t = 4 hours (which is 2 half-lives of A and 1 half-life of B), R_A(4) = R_A(0) × (1/2)² = R_A(0)/4, and R_B(4) = R_B(0) × (1/2)¹ = R_B(0)/2. Ratio = (2 / 4) / (1 / 2) = 1.0.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (IIT JAM Physics (PH) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (1.0..1.0) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
Initial activity ratio R_A(0)/R_B(0) = (λ_A N_0)/(λ_B N_0) = T_B / T_A = 4 / 2 = 2. After t = 4 hours (which is 2 half-lives of A and 1 half-life of B), R_A(4) = R_A(0) × (1/2)² = R_A(0)/4, and R_B(4) = R_B(0) × (1/2)¹ = R_B(0)/2. Ratio = (2 / 4) / (1 / 2) = 1.0.
